name: beacon
description: Control plane for a fleet of self-updating agents: the panel installs them, they report in, it serves their updates.

scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --fix libs/contract/src apps/be/src apps/be/scripts apps/agent/src apps/agent/scripts apps/fe/src e2e
scripts.lint:check: oxlint --type-aware --max-warnings 0 libs/contract/src apps/be/src apps/be/scripts apps/agent/src apps/agent/scripts apps/fe/src e2e
scripts.svc:install: bun run build && sudo cp deploy/beacon-panel.service /etc/systemd/system/beacon-panel.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now beacon-panel
scripts.svc:restart: bun run build && sudo systemctl restart beacon-panel
scripts.svc:uninstall: sudo systemctl disable --now beacon-panel && sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/beacon-panel.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload
